business_problem: Cohesity needed to improve customer support by reducing customers' time to action and time to resolution while scaling access to its SRE knowledge without requiring a support technician for every issue.
solution_summary: Cohesity implemented an AI-driven Support Experience for its own support operation, powered by Cohesity Turing and delivered as a chat-based interface for customers. The system captures the knowledge base of Cohesity Site Reliability Engineers and makes it available through AI agents that act like virtual SREs or support technicians. The source says the agents use Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models together with retrieval augmented generation (RAG) to access knowledge base repositories and issue resolution systems at response time, so users receive current remediation guidance instead of static FAQs. The implementation also includes a feedback loop: SREs continue producing deep technical documentation and issue write-ups, and those learnings are fed back into AI agent stream workflows to continuously improve the support experience and expand coverage for both common and novel issues.

solution_components.name: Cohesity Turing
solution_components.role: Powers the AI-driven Support Experience and delivers the chat-based support interface customers use.

solution_components.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
solution_components.role: Helps the AI agents interpret customer issues and identify likely root causes from natural-language interactions.

solution_components.name: Large Language Models (LLMs)
solution_components.role: Generate diagnosis and remediation guidance for routine and complex support issues.

solution_components.name: retrieval augmented generation (RAG)
solution_components.role: Connects the AI models to current knowledge base repositories and issue resolution systems for just-in-time answers.

data_flow: Customer questions enter a chat experience powered by Cohesity Turing, where AI agents use NLP and LLMs with RAG to pull context from Cohesity knowledge base repositories and issue resolution systems, generate diagnosis and remediation steps, and return guidance to the user. New SRE write-ups and technical learnings are then fed back into AI agent stream workflows to improve future responses.
business_outcome: The support experience enables customers to self-serve with AI-powered guidance, reduces time to resolution, and lets Cohesity SREs focus on more complex issues while continuously improving support quality.
metrics: reducing overall customer time to resolution by up to 40%
